specs.Sensor Type: Heart Rate Sensor, Hrv Sensor, Spo2 Sensor, Stress Monitoring Sensor, Sleep Tracking Sensor

features: HEART RATE & HRV ANALYSIS: Continuously monitors your heart rate and analyses Heart Rate Variability to give deeper insights into your cardiovascular health.
STRESS & SLEEP TRACKING: Tracks your stress levels throughout the day and monitors sleep stages to help you understand and improve your overall well-being.
25+ DAYS BATTERY LIFE: Long-lasting battery keeps the fitness band running for over 25 days on a single charge, reducing the need for frequent recharging.
30+ SPORTS MODES: Supports more than 30 sports modes to accurately track a wide variety of workouts and physical activities tailored to your fitness goals.
SUBSCRIPTION FREE: Enjoy full access to all health and fitness features without any recurring subscription charges or hidden fees.
description: The Nex-Q2 Smart Fitness Band is a powerful health companion designed to keep you on top of your wellness goals around the clock. Equipped with continuous heart rate monitoring and advanced HRV (Heart Rate Variability) analysis, it gives you deep insights into your cardiovascular health and recovery levels. The built-in stress monitoring feature helps you understand and manage your daily stress patterns, while comprehensive sleep tracking analyses your sleep stages to help you wake up feeling truly rested. With an impressive battery life of 25+ days on a single charge, you can wear it through your busiest weeks without interruption. Whether you are a runner, swimmer, cyclist, or yoga enthusiast, the 30+ sports modes ensure accurate tracking for virtually every activity. Best of all, the Nex-Q2 requires no subscription, giving you full access to all its features without any recurring charges. A smart, reliable, and feature-rich fitness band for those who take their health seriously.
